```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)

figure_dir <- here("results", "figures")
table_dir <- here("results", "tables")
```

## Compare siting-model performance

```{r siting-performance}
siting_performance <- read_csv(
  file.path(table_dir, "siting_model_performance.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

performance_long <- siting_performance |>
  select(
    Year, model, auc, accuracy,
    sensitivity, false_positive_rate, precision
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Year, model),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    metric = recode(
      metric,
      auc = "AUC",
      accuracy = "Accuracy",
      sensitivity = "True-positive rate",
      false_positive_rate = "False-positive rate",
      precision = "Precision"
    )
  )

performance_plot <- ggplot(
  performance_long,
  aes(x = Year, y = value, group = model, linetype = model)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2017:2023) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Performance",
    linetype = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "siting_model_performance.png"),
  performance_plot,
  width = 9,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

performance_plot
```

## Summarize random-forest variable importance

```{r rf-importance}
rf_importance <- read_csv(
  file.path(table_dir, "random_forest_importance.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

rf_importance_summary <- rf_importance |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  mutate(
    normalized_importance =
      importance / max(importance, na.rm = TRUE),
    annual_rank = min_rank(desc(importance))
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(variable) |>
  summarise(
    mean_normalized_importance =
      mean(normalized_importance, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rank = mean(annual_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    years_in_top_10 = sum(annual_rank <= 10, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(mean_rank)

write_csv(
  rf_importance_summary,
  file.path(table_dir, "random_forest_importance_summary.csv")
)

rf_importance_summary
```

## TWFE lead/current/lag coefficient plot

Edit the three selections below to reproduce the manuscript figure of
interest.

```{r twfe-plot}
selected_outcome <- "rent_burden_30p"
selected_ev_variable <- "PointCount_1mi"
selected_income_specification <- TRUE

twfe_results <- read_csv(
  file.path(table_dir, "twfe_full_results.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

plot_data <- twfe_results |>
  filter(
    outcome == selected_outcome,
    ev_base == selected_ev_variable,
    include_income == selected_income_specification
  ) |>
  mutate(
    timing = factor(
      timing,
      levels = c("Lead (t+2)", "Current", "Lag (t-2)")
    )
  )

if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
  stop("The selected TWFE specification was not found.")
}

timing_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(x = timing, y = estimate)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = conf_low, ymax = conf_high),
    width = 0.12
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Coefficient estimate",
    title = paste(
      selected_ev_variable,
      "and",
      selected_outcome
    ),
    subtitle = "Two-way fixed effects; 95% confidence intervals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_dir,
    paste0(
      "twfe_",
      selected_outcome,
      "_",
      selected_ev_variable,
      ".png"
    )
  ),
  timing_plot,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 4.5,
  dpi = 300
)

timing_plot
```

## Current-effect robustness plot

```{r robustness-plot}
current_effects <- twfe_results |>
  filter(
    outcome == selected_outcome,
    timing == "Current",
    include_income == selected_income_specification
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ev_base = fct_reorder(ev_base, estimate)
  )

robustness_plot <- ggplot(
  current_effects,
  aes(x = estimate, y = ev_base)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = conf_low, xmax = conf_high),
    height = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Contemporaneous coefficient estimate",
    y = NULL,
    title = selected_outcome,
    subtitle = "Alternative EV exposure definitions and distances"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_dir,
    paste0("twfe_robustness_", selected_outcome, ".png")
  ),
  robustness_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)

robustness_plot
```
